scope: Additional explicitly cited references; preserve all historical saved cases and their original evidence.

cases.title: Noh cold-inflow shock: planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry
cases.assumptions: Ideal-gas Euler, gamma=5/3, rho0=1, inward speed 1, p0=0; r in [0,1], t=0.6. Planar (d=1), cylindrical-radial (d=2) and spherical-radial (d=3) finite-volume calculations without a pressure floor. The spherical color picture is a central section of one-dimensional radial data, not a Cartesian three-dimensional computation. A separate full-square2D Cartesian calculation uses [-.5,.5]^2 with32²/64²/128² cells, both momenta and no radial reduction. Its density-cell reference is shock-split quadrature, checked at orders64/128.
cases.reference_scope: Analytic continuous solution and independently evaluated ExactPack values. Conserved-volume averages are the FV reference; primitive pressure of a conserved average is distinguished from averaged analytic pressure. The PDE numerical solution is Atlas original code.
